type get_fraction_csp3 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

// Return Wildman–Crippen molar refractivity (MR).
type get_mol_mr = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

smiles: string

smiles: string

type get_labute_asa = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_bertz_ct = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_hall_kier_alpha = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_kappa1 = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

smiles: string
}) => any;

}) => any;

type get_num_unspecified_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;
